sentences: The latest build crashes when I open the results tab.
Can you try running it again after pulling the changes?
It worked this time, but the plot looked blank.
I think the axis label is missing because the export failed.
Sorry, I meant the PDF export, not the PNG one.
Are you free for ten minutes to look at this?
I can do after lunch if that helps.
The experiment finished, but the log file is empty.
Did you check whether the path was set before the run?
Yes, I set it in the config file this morning.
Maybe it's using the old path from yesterday.
I'll restart the service and see if that fixes it.
Please don't delete the data folder before I check it.
I won't, I just moved it to the archive.
Can you confirm which version you're using?
It says 2.4.1 in the title bar.
That's the one with the timing bug.
Is there a workaround for today?
You can disable auto-refresh in the settings.
That seems to have stopped the freeze.
The results still don't match what I expected.
Did you run the same control sample?
Yes, same batch and same temperature.
Maybe the units are off again.
I'll compare the raw output with the last good run.
Send me the file when you have a chance.
It's in the shared folder now.
Thanks, I'll take a look after this meeting.
The button is greyed out for some users.
Does it happen on the web app too?
No, only on the desktop version.
That points to a permissions issue.
I can ask IT to reset the profile.
Please do, but keep a copy of the settings first.
I backed them up to the network drive.
The export took almost ten minutes.
That's longer than usual.
Maybe the server is overloaded.
I'll try a smaller range and see.
That should be enough to test it.
Can you add a progress bar?
It's on my list, but not until next week.
Next week is too late for this report.
What if I make a temporary script for you?
That would help, as long as it's documented.
I'll add a short README.
The script needs Python, right?
Yes, and the data package from the internal repo.
I don't have access to that repo.
I'll request it for you now.
Did you get the confirmation email?
Not yet, maybe it went to spam.
Check the shared drive instead.
Found it, thanks.
The numbers changed after I reran it.
That shouldn't happen unless the seed changed.
I didn't touch the seed.
Maybe the input file was updated.
I'll check the file timestamp.
It was modified this morning.
Who changed it?
Not me, maybe the automated pipeline.
We need to freeze the inputs before analysis.
Agreed, I'll add a checksum step.
Can you test the new installer?
Sure, I'll run it on the test machine.
It installed, but the shortcut is broken.
I'll fix the path in the next build.
Is there a way to undo the last import?
Not safely, I'm afraid.
That's unfortunate.
We should add a dry-run option.
Good idea, I'll put it in the backlog.
The chart is too small on my screen.
You can resize the window or use full screen.
Full screen works, but the labels overlap.
I'll adjust the layout for smaller displays.
Please test it on the lab monitor too.
That one has a different resolution.
Yes, and it's connected through the dock.
